replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body: This player will be banned when a full mod comes online. There was a slight error in communication between myself and another staff member. Cowlcowl was banned falsely while caucow was not banned, I told the full mod to ban caucow ( whilst I was speaking to him through TS) he had misheard me and banned Cowlcowl. The whole situation is being sorted out as we speak and I am personally sorry for the mishap.

replies.body: Junior moderators do not have permission to make use of the "permanent ban" command? If so, then I assume your rank is like a spectator mode to moderators rather than a participatory rank. Am I correct?

replies.body:

However, as D00ZiE stated, Junior Moderators do not get temp ban or ban.
